clayresearch.delta: Safe-Effect and loop-of-loops converge on a dependency-scoped commit envelope: decision read-set + capability epoch/validity. Global epoch is safe but over-conservative in the synthetic model.

frank.delta: Effect-bearing recurrent decisions should carry proposal/decision identity and be revalidated before commit. This is Research-Entity research about Frank, not a Frank self-harness change.

claycode.delta: Candidate work for WP04/07/09/11: compiler-emitted dependency metadata, runtime commit envelope, capability epoch, retry/abort receipts. No new syntax requested.

claygraph.delta: Represent dependency/capability/loop topology as epoch-bound derived observability only; graph activation never authorizes commit.

unifieddb.delta: Persist distinct semantic-state versions, authority epochs, decision snapshots, commit results and retry/recovery receipts. Compare whole-ledger CAS vs object/invariant-group versions.

gwt.delta: Ignition/selection can route compute, but permit lifetime does not follow GWT recurrence. Add stale-authority/decision-freshness negative controls to effect-path replays.

emergenz.delta: Safe/stale commit differences are systems-security/transaction evidence, not emergence evidence. If used in emergence studies, treat as controlled intervention metadata only.

hyperposition.delta: Effect-distinct alternatives must preserve separate dependency identities until selection/commit; topology/alternative collapse must not erase authority-flow distinctions.

harness.delta: Highest-information H1 test: replay effect-bearing episodes under current whole-ledger base_epoch CAS and dependency-scoped versions with unrelated churn, revoke/regrant, delayed queues and crash/restart; compare safety, false aborts, latency and recovery.
